brief:
Israeli airstrikes killed children in Gaza on the first day of the school year, according to Zeteo's weekly roundup of developments in occupied Gaza and the West Bank. The strikes struck as students returned to classrooms following a break in the academic calendar.

The incident represents part of the broader pattern of Israeli military operations in Gaza, where sustained strikes have caused extensive civilian casualties. Zeteo's coverage this week documented the school deaths alongside other developments unfolding across Gaza and the West Bank, including consequences of the ongoing war and Israeli policies in the occupied territories.
dek: Zeteo’s weekly round-up of the stories you may have missed out of occupied Gaza and the West Bank, as Israel continues its genocidal war and apartheid policies.
title: Israeli strikes kill children as Gaza schools reopen
